title: Bootstrap gated demo emulators and pinned provider adapter dependencies
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Only after G4, review primary provider compatibility documentation and add pinned server/browser Firebase SDK plus emulator-test dependencies required by the approved adapters. Root lockfile/client manifest changes are explicitly owned bootstrap coordination,not permission to implement browser transport. Implement and invoke the owned emulator-target preflight before any SDK/CLI initialization; validate loopback hosts, explicit ports, demo project IDs and absence of ambient production credential selection without reading secret files. Generate emulator-only nonsecret configuration into temporary ignored storage,require a demo project ID and loopback endpoints,run only required Auth/Firestore/Functions components,and clean children/config/ports on success,failure,timeout or signal. No committed Firebase app/project config,aliases,service accounts or deploy scripts. Firebase gate G4 is externally blocked by D-FIREBASE-PROJECT: Sergio must create/provide the project before any Firebase worker, SDK/configuration or provider adapter is implemented. Do not create/configure a project, discover credentials or make live calls. Once that gate is satisfied, this ticket still uses demo/loopback emulators and injected clients only; no project IDs, app config, tokens or service accounts are committed.
acceptance: Approved pinned provider dependencies and emulator test seams are reproducible without unowned manifest edits.
The harness refuses remote/live endpoints,ambient production project selection or credential-discovery initialization before spawning SDK/CLI.
Temporary config/processes/ports are cleaned after success,failure,timeout and interruption with bounded waits.
Injected-process unit tests verify exact arguments/preflight ordering and no project creation,configuration commit or deployment.
